Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#939)
Old proofs of these Christmas stories have fortunately been discovered so I send them off herewith.[^1]
I find I must ask you to be kind enough to let me have [£200 on account](../others.html#160), or else £100 now and another £100 before Christmas.

There have been some unexpected calls upon me which drive me to ask this favour of you, though I am sorry to have to do so so early in the year

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
I suppose [Magnum Bonum](../books.html#131) will soon be put in hand

[^1]: She had been assembling the stories which were republished as [Bye-Words](../books.html#135) (1880).
